propositions: The .bridge_state cache contributes 92% of tickets branch size (950+ MiB of 1.04 GiB) due to scattered edits in bindings.json that defeat git delta compression; baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass fields are written frequently but read nowhere.

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp reduces marginal cost per committed version from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB; moving last_get_pass bookkeeping to a separate get_rotation.json halves the version count and achieves 12.8x total cost reduction.

The .bridge_state cache must remain committed to git because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners; the cache cannot be relocated off-branch without re-deriving 2050+ inbound creates on every pass.

A history-strip operation using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces existing history from 1.17 GiB to 98.8 MiB (8.4% final size) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges; the rewritten HEAD tree is byte-identical to the pre-rewrite tip.

Mixed-version read compatibility must be maintained during rollout: A2-1 writes both legacy and new formats; A2-2 stops legacy writes but continues reading max(new, legacy) with automatic migration; post-deployment epoch validation at union and push sites prevents stale-clone corruption.

Rollback is operator-controlled via quiesced window, off-repo backup bundle restore, epoch refusal abort triggers in sync._union_merge and push.py, and mandatory re-clone of all writers; no in-flight application bypass is permitted.
